name: SHARP 2T-C32GH3000I
summary: SHARP 2T-C32GH3000I (Indonesia) ships with Skyworth telemetry and ad services. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This 32-inch Sharp set is built by Skyworth and runs Google TV 14 with about 1 GB of memory. It ships with telemetry and activation services, Android ad and personalization services, content and recommendations, cleaners, manuals and unused apps. A memory pass also switches off six more apps, because the set was swapping.

It was applied and checked on one TV, with a restart afterwards. Live TV, HDMI and YouTube and Netflix playback worked, and the real remote's buttons did too. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Live TV and the HDMI and tuner inputs
Google voice search and the phone remote link
The keyboard, text-to-speech and Dolby audio
notes: Debugging was only offered as Wireless debugging on this set.
The Wi-Fi network from first setup belonged to the setup helper. Forget it and rejoin in Settings before that helper is switched off, or the TV drops off Wi-Fi.
Searching for content by voice fails once the stock home screen is off. Simple commands like 'open YouTube' still work.
Private DNS works, but one ISP buffered with AdGuard and not with Cloudflare.

faq.a: Partly. Commands like 'open YouTube' work. Searching for content by voice fails once the stock home screen is off.

faq.q: Will the remote keys still work?
faq.a: Yes. Home, Input, Settings and the app buttons worked on the real remote with the key helpers on.

faq.q: Does it have a way back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on in one tap, and puts the old home screen back if you changed it.
